     6

Update accompanying documentation to remove the interim type-safety advisory.
    10	
    11	## Scope
    12	
    13	- `mcp-server/tests/gui/helpers/make-project.ts` — type definition and JSDoc changes
    14	- `mcp-server/tests/gui/README.md` — removal of type-safety advisory
    15	
    16	## Deliverables
    17	
    18	- Updated `MakeProjectOpts` interface with explicit optional fields (`project_comments`, `project_name`, `server_version`, `ledger_version`) and no index signature
    19	- Updated JSDoc block confirming full type coverage (replacing the "Type-safety tradeoff" section)
    20	- Removal of the type-safety advisory from `tests/gui/README.md`
    21	
    22	## Dependencies
    23	
    24	- None
    25	
    26	## Acceptance Criteria
    27	
    28	1. The `MakeProjectOpts` interface no longer contains a `[key: string]: unknown` index signature.
    29	2. All root-level keys returned by the `makeProject` factory (`meta`, `work_packages`, `project_comments`, `project_name`, `timing`, `server_version`, `ledger_version`, `synthesis_generated`) are represented as explicit optional fields in `MakeProjectOpts`.
    30	3. `npm run typecheck` inside `mcp-server/` passes with no type errors across all 7 test files that import `makeProject`.
    31	4. The "Type-safety tradeoff" JSDoc section in `make-project.ts` is replaced with a note confirming full type coverage.
    32	5. The type-safety advisory in `tests/gui/README.md` is removed.
    33	6. All existing tests pass (`npm test` inside `mcp-server/`).
    34	
    35	## Active Pipeline Stages
    36	
    37	`implementation` → `qa` → `code-review` → `documentation`
    38	
    39	## Estimated Complexity
    40	
    41	Low
    42	
    43	## Rationale
    44	
    45	The `[key: string]: unknown` escape hatch was an intentional DX tradeoff when the fixture API was new. Now that all 7 test files use the shared helper, the strictness benefit outweighs the minor ergonomic cost of listing extra keys explicitly.

    48	
    49	- **Branded type + runtime check:** Adds unnecessary runtime overhead for what is purely a compile-time concern.

This gives 13 deterministic, fast tests without Playwright overhead while still exercising the 14 DOM rendering logic. 15 16 ### Shared Setup File — `setup-gui-globals.ts` 17 18 `mcp-server/vitest.config.ts` registers `tests/gui/setup-gui-globals.ts` as a 19 `setupFiles` entry. This file runs automatically **before every test file** and: 20 21 1. Loads `utils.js` into `globalThis` (provides `escapeHtml`, `formatDate`, 22 `showLoading`, `showError`, `statusBadge`, `breadcrumb`, `ProjectNameCache`, …). 23 2. Loads `components.js` into `globalThis` (provides the `UI` namespace — `UI.badge`, 24 `UI.banner`, `UI.emptyState`, `UI.card`, `UI.filterBar`). 25 3. Installs a `localStorage` stub on the Node `global` so that view scripts calling 26 `localStorage.getItem/setItem` inside `vm.runInThisContext` don't throw. 27 28 The setup file is guarded by `typeof document !== 'undefined'`, so it is a no-op for 29 server-side tests that run in the default Node environment. 30 31 > **`localStorage` stub limitations:** The stub implements `getItem`, `setItem`, 32 > `removeItem`, and `clear` only. It does **not** implement `key()`, `length`, or 33 > `storage` events. If a view script begins iterating `localStorage.length` or 34 > listening for `StorageEvent`, the stub must be extended (or replaced with jsdom's 35 > built-in `window.localStorage`). Server-side test files that run in the Node 36 > environment are unaffected — the stub is only installed when `document` exists. 37 38 > **`showError()` delegates to `UI.banner()`:** Since WP-2 rework, `showError()` 39 > in `utils.js` calls `UI.banner('error', message)` and therefore emits 40 > `

…

`. Tests that need to intercept `showError` should 41 > override it with a `vi.fn()` spy in their own `beforeAll` (after the setup file 42 > has loaded `utils.js`). 43 44 ### Script Loading Order — Per-Test Pattern 45 46 Each test file only needs to load its **view-specific** scripts in `beforeAll`. 47 `utils.js` and `components.js` are already loaded by the shared setup file — do not 48 re-load them. 49 50 ```typescript 51 import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; 52 import { join } from 'node:path'; 53 import vm from 'node:vm'; 54 55 const publicDir = join(__dirname, '../../gui/public'); 56 // utils.js and components.js are loaded by setup-gui-globals.ts — omit them here. 57 const myViewJs = readFileSync(join(publicDir, 'views/my-view.js'), 'utf-8'); 58 59 beforeAll(() => { 60 // Set any view-specific stubs or overrides first, then load the view script. 61 vm.runInThisContext(myViewJs); 62 }); 63 ``` 64 65 **⚠️ Do not re-load `utils.js` or `components.js`.** The setup file already loads 66 them once per test file. Duplicate `vm.runInThisContext` calls are harmless but 67 wasteful. 68 69 ### Dependency Graph 70 71 ``` 72 utils.js → defines escapeHtml, formatDate, breadcrumb, statusBadge, 73 showLoading, showError (→ UI.banner), etc. 74 components.js → defines UI (badge, banner, emptyState, card, filterBar); 75 depends on escapeHtml from utils.js 76 api-client.js → defines API; depends on nothing (uses fetch) 77 orchestrator-widgets.js → defines OrchestratorWidgets; depends on escapeHtml, UI 78 views/*.js → depend on utils.js + components.js; some also need API / OrchestratorWidgets 79 ``` 80 81 ### TypeScript Global Declarations 82 83 View scripts write to `globalThis` via IIFE assignments. TypeScript needs matching 84 `declare global` entries so the test file can reference these names without type errors: 85 86 ```typescript 87 declare global { 88 // eslint-disable-next-line no-var 89 var UI: { 90 badge: (type: string, label: string, opts?: { attrs?: Record }) => string; 91 banner: (type: string, message: string) => string; 92 emptyState: (message: string) => string; 93 }; 94 // eslint-disable-next-line no-var 95 var escapeHtml: (s: any) => string; 96 // ... declare other globals consumed by the view under test 97 } 98 ``` 99 100 ### Examples
